quests.title: Sightseeing With Friends: Underwater Fun

dialogue.t: Ta-da! We're here! Let's go in from this shallow bit. It'll feel like we're walking into a painting — one that unfolds right before our very eyes!
Ah... It's you. And you've brought some new companions? Are they... Fungi? I've only ever read about them...
What a lovely surprise, a Melusine's hanging out here!

dialogue.sit: Good to see you again, Marine.

dialogue.t: I'm not "hanging out," I'm picking Tidalga for this year's pickled batch. A lot of the others have returned to the village to help too.
Enghiene and little Roxane both took leave to come back and help. They're hard at work right now, and I'll be heading into the water myself in a bit.
You know... Enghiene wasn't wrong. The blue Fungi really do look a bit like Tidalga...
Not in a food sense! I just meant they're cute. Nothing else...
Hehe~ You've got a good eye for cuteness!

dialogue.sit: Our Fungi friends really are adorable.

dialogue.t: Anyway, really nice meeting you. I should get going — enjoy the rest of your time here!
Okay, shall we head out too? We're gonna get some amazing underwater shots in Fontaine with our Fungi friends!

quests.description: Besides the iconic photo spot right outside the Court of Fontaine, Paimon seems to have an underwater tour planned as well…
